pages.text: After summoning the Toxifin Slab (a poisonous potato variant of the Guardian) with that joke of a staff, you began to wonder if you could use it to obtain a different kind of Elder Guardian...
Transform a Toxifin Slab Servant into a Plaguewhale Slab Servant through a ritual.
It is said that the Plaguewhale Slab is an Elder Guardian twisted by the power of the poisonous potato.
